dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: What's new in the latest scan and where to start.
dashboard.noScans: No scan has results yet. Import targets and start a scan.
dashboard.newest: Newest scan of {{date}}, compared with the scan of {{base}}.
dashboard.newestFirst: Newest scan of {{date}}. It is the first one, so there is nothing to compare it with yet.

top.title: Most important changes
top.empty: Nothing changed since the previous scan.

targets.title: Targets
targets.subtitle: IP addresses, ranges and domains to scan.

search.label: Search targets
search.placeholder: Search by address, domain or tag

form.tagsInvalid: Up to 20 tags, each at most 50 characters.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{value}}?
confirmDelete.description: It leaves the inventory and new scans. Results of past scans are kept.

import.title: Add targets
import.subtitle: Type in addresses, ranges (up to /16) and domains, or upload a CSV or JSON file.

entry.valueHint: Enter adds it to the list, Shift+Enter starts a new line. Paste a list to add many at once; text after a comma becomes the note.
entry.empty: Type an IP address (192.0.2.15), a CIDR range (10.0.0.0/24), an IP range (10.0.0.1-200) or a domain (example.com).

detected.domain: resolved to IPv4 addresses when the scan is queued

entry.alreadyListed_one: {{count, number}} was already on the list.
entry.alreadyListed_other: {{count, number}} were already on the list.
entry.toFix: Still in the field, to fix:

leave.title: Leave without importing?
leave.description_one: {{count, number}} entry on the list has not been imported and will be lost.
leave.description_other: {{count, number}} entries on the list have not been imported and will be lost.

text.label: Targets
text.hint: One target per line (an IP, CIDR, range such as 10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50, or domain), optionally followed by a comma and a note. Lines starting with # are skipped.

csv.hint: One target per row with an optional note in the next column. A header row (target, note) is optional; columns may be separated by a comma, semicolon or tab.

json.hint: An array of addresses, or of objects with target and note fields, optionally under a targets key.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Enter targets or choose a file to see what will be imported.
preview.breakdown: IP: {{ip, number}} · CIDR: {{cidr, number}} · Domains: {{domain, number}}

issues.invalid_format: Not an IPv4 address, CIDR, IP range or domain
issues.reserved_range: Reserved range (loopback, link-local, multicast or broadcast)
issues.invalid_range: The range ends before it starts
issues.cidr_normalized: Host bits cleared to the network address
issues.single_host_cidr: A /32 range is imported as a single address
issues.url_stripped: URL reduced to its host name
issues.range_split: IP range saved as CIDR blocks

listErrors.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
listErrors.unsupported_json_shape: Expected an array of targets or an object with a targets array.
listErrors.too_many_entries: More than 100,000 targets in one import.
listErrors.too_many_addresses: More than 1,048,576 IP addresses in one import.
listErrors.too_many_domains: More than 1,000 domains in one import.

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Optional. Given to the targets this import adds; targets already on the list keep their tags.
tags.invalid: Up to 20 tags, each at most 50 characters.

startScan.label: Start a scan right away
startScan.hint: Domains are resolved to IP addresses and all addresses are split into scan jobs for the workers.

result.title: Import finished
result.skipped_one: {{count, number}} target was already on the list
result.skipped_other: {{count, number}} targets were already on the list

warnings.dns_no_addresses: The domain has no IPv4 address (A record)
warnings.resolves_to_reserved: Points to a reserved address, which was skipped
warnings.no_scannable_targets: Nothing was left to scan, so no scan was queued.
warnings.worker_not_registered: No worker manager has registered this worker yet, so its step was left out.

scans.title: Scans
scans.subtitle: All scans. Open one to see its hosts and what changed.

detail.title: Scan of {{date}}
detail.subtitle: What this scan found and what changed since the last one.
detail.comparedWith: Compared with the scan of {{date}}. Click a number to show only those hosts.
detail.firstScan: This is the first scan of these addresses, so there is nothing to compare it with yet.
detail.pausedHint: The time window closed with jobs left. They continue at the pipeline's next run time.
detail.stopDescription: Queued jobs are cancelled. Jobs a worker is already running finish first, then the scan ends.

visualization.title: Scan visualization
visualization.description: Addresses grouped by shared IP prefixes. Links show logical grouping, not measured network connections. Expand a group to see its hosts.
visualization.empty: This scan has no hosts to visualize yet.
visualization.tagDescription: Add a tag to hosts from this scan in {{address}}.
visualization.tagInvalid: Enter a tag with 1 to 50 characters.
visualization.tagLimited: {{count}} hosts reached the tag limit and were skipped.
visualization.noHosts: No hosts in this scan match this address.
visualization.targetDescription: Choose what to add from {{address}}. This will not start a scan.
visualization.onlyScanned: Only the {{count}} host IPs found in this scan
visualization.entireCidr: The whole {{cidr}} range, including addresses not found in this scan
visualization.tooManyTargets: This group contains {{count}} IPs, more than one import allows.
visualization.invalidTarget: {{value}} cannot be added as a target.

edit.title: Name and note of the scan
edit.description: For telling scans apart and for what the team should know about this one. What the scan found does not change.
edit.name: Name
edit.nameHint: Shown in the scan list next to the date.

remove.title: Delete the scan of {{scan}}?
remove.description: Its results are removed for good. Hosts keep their notes, tags and triage, and the other scans are compared with each other from now on.

import.title: Import scan results
import.subtitle: Load a results file as a new scan.
import.hint: JSON: a file from Export JSON on a scan, or one or more worker results. CSV: the columns of Export CSV; only an address column is required.
import.empty: Choose a file to see what it holds.

preview.title: What the file holds
preview.ranUnknown: Not recorded. The scan will be placed at the time of the import.
preview.placement: The scan takes its place among the others by when it ran, so a newer scan may be compared with it from now on.
preview.warningsTitle_one: {{count, number}} part of the file will be skipped
preview.warningsTitle_other: {{count, number}} parts of the file will be skipped

issues.not_json: The file is not valid JSON.
issues.unknown_format: Neither a scan export nor a worker result.
issues.unsupported_version: Written by a newer version of the export (version {{detail}}).
issues.invalid_document: The scan export does not match its format: {{detail}}
issues.invalid_result: A worker result does not match the result format: {{detail}}
issues.multiple_scans: The results belong to more than one scan. Import each scan's results separately.
issues.too_many_addresses: The file covers {{detail}} addresses; the limit is 1,048,576.
issues.too_many_up_hosts: The file has {{detail}} hosts up; the limit is 20,000.
issues.too_many_results: The file has {{detail}} worker results; the limit is 4,096.
issues.missing_ip_column: No address column. One column must be named ip.
issues.conflicting_status: Two statuses for one address ({{detail}}). The first one counts.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Shown in the scan list. The file's name unless you change it.

edits.label: Apply the notes, tags, triage and corrections from the file
edits.hint: Only where a host or service has none yet. Nothing set here is overwritten.

result.title: Scan imported
result.hosts: Hosts up: {{up, number}} · Down: {{down, number}} · No answer: {{noAnswer, number}} · Open ports: {{ports, number}}
result.edits: Edits applied: {{applied, number}} · Already set here: {{kept, number}} · Not part of the scan: {{missing, number}}
result.warnings_one: {{count, number}} part of the file was skipped.
result.warnings_other: {{count, number}} parts of the file were skipped.

compare.title: Compare scans
compare.subtitle: Two scans side by side: what appeared, disappeared or changed.
compare.selectScan: Select the scan of {{date}} for comparison
compare.noBase: There is no older scan with results to compare this one with. Choose another scan as B.
compare.noScans: Comparing needs at least two scans with results.
compare.coverage: Both scans answered for {{both}} addresses. Only A: {{onlyBase}}, only B: {{onlyCurrent}}. A host outside the common part is unknown, never new or gone.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: Your role does not include the permission this page needs: {{permission}}.

file.label: File
file.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{size}} MB.
file.unreadable: The file could not be read.

mock.tooltip: This page shows sample data generated in the browser. The backend does not serve it yet, so changes made here are not saved.

defectdojo.title: DefectDojo
defectdojo.never: Never synced. A sync imports finding tags, asset tags and owners, triage of unreviewed services and remediation dates.
defectdojo.notConfigured: Not configured: set DEFECTDOJO_URL and DEFECTDOJO_API_TOKEN on the backend.
defectdojo.running: Sync started {{when}} by {{by}} is still running.
defectdojo.succeeded: Last sync {{when}} by {{by}}: {{matched}} of {{findings}} findings matched, {{services}} services and {{hosts}} hosts updated, {{tags}} tags added.
defectdojo.hint: Pull the current DefectDojo data. Tags are added to yours; your triage and edits are never overwritten.
defectdojo.toast: DefectDojo synced: {{services}} services and {{hosts}} hosts updated

push.hint: Every service of this scan as an informational finding in the DefectDojo product “SubSurf discovery”.
push.confirmScan: Each service becomes an Info finding with its triage and tags. Findings of services this scan no longer sees are closed in DefectDojo; hosts that did not answer keep theirs.
push.confirmSelection: Only the selected hosts (all their services) and services are sent. Nothing is closed in DefectDojo.
push.last: Last push {{when}} by {{by}}: {{findings}} findings, {{created}} new, {{closed}} closed.
